problem.heading: Running the shop is hard work already. Why worry about credit books too?
problem.intro: So many transactions happen in your shop every day. Remembering all of them is not easy.
problem.card1Desc: Opening the book, finding the name and writing the amount, in the middle of work, is hard.
problem.card2Title: Small dues add up to big amounts
problem.card2Desc: ₹100 today, ₹250 tomorrow, ₹500 another day. Small amounts add up, and you may not notice how much.
problem.card3Desc: Finding old entries, remembering past payments and telling customers their dues all take time.
problem.closing: Give more time to your business. Make your accounts simple.

howItWorks.heading: Using GetLekka is simple — just speak.
howItWorks.step1Title: Say it in your own words
howItWorks.step1Desc: Send a WhatsApp voice message when you give credit or receive money. Example: "Mahesh ne 500 de diya."
howItWorks.step2Desc: GetLekka understands your note and records it in the right customer's account. It shows you the amount recorded and the new balance. If something is wrong, check the entry and tap Undo.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Ask "Who owes how much?" and get all customer balances in one message. You can also get a payment reminder ready, and send it yourself from your own WhatsApp.

features.heading: Simple tools for your shop's everyday accounts.
features.f1Desc: Instead of opening a book and writing, just speak. Record your accounts in Kannada, Hindi, English or a mix.
features.f2Desc: See who owes how much, and get a ready message with the amount and your UPI ID. Check it, then send it from your own WhatsApp.
features.f3Desc: Say the day's amounts one by one. GetLekka adds them up and shows the total.
features.f4Desc: No need to keep checking the day's accounts. See the day's sales, credit given, money collected and pending dues in one summary.
features.f5Desc: Check every recorded entry. If something is wrong, tap Undo to take it back.
features.f6Desc: No new app to download. Talk to GetLekka in the WhatsApp you already use.

languagesStrip.heading: Speak in your language. GetLekka understands.
languagesStrip.sub: You don't need to learn a new language to keep accounts. Speak the way you talk every day.

trust.heading: Your shop's accounts. Your control.
trust.intro: Trust matters when money is involved. That is why GetLekka only helps you keep records.
trust.p1Title: We don't need your UPI PIN.
trust.p1: We will never ask for your UPI PIN, OTP or bank password. Only your UPI ID is needed, to show in payment reminders.
trust.p2: GetLekka never moves money on your behalf. It is only a tool to help you keep accounts and track dues.
trust.p3: GetLekka prepares the payment reminder. You check it and send it yourself.
trust.p4: How your accounts data is collected and used is explained clearly in our Privacy Policy. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.

pricingTeaser.heading: Simple pricing for small shops. No confusion.
pricingTeaser.intro: The free pilot in Karnataka is starting soon. We want to learn from the first pilot shops and improve GetLekka for your needs.

faq.heading: Simple answers to your questions.
faq.q1: Do I need to install a new app?
faq.a1: No. GetLekka is designed to work through WhatsApp. There is nothing new to download.
faq.a2: Yes. You can speak in Kannada, Hindi or English, and you can mix them.
faq.q3: What if it records something wrong?
faq.a3: Check the recorded entry. If something is wrong, tap Undo to take it back.
faq.q4: Is my shop's account information safe?
faq.a4: We explain how we collect and use your information in our Privacy Policy. We never need your UPI PIN, OTP or bank password. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.
faq.q5: Will GetLekka message my customers directly?
faq.a5: No. GetLekka prepares the payment reminder. You check it and send it from your own WhatsApp.
faq.a6: It is free during the pilot. Planned prices after the pilot are Basic ₹149 and Pro ₹299 per month, and may change.

finalCta.heading: Ready to make your shop's accounts simpler?
finalCta.sub: Stop searching book pages for credit entries. Just speak — GetLekka helps you keep your accounts. Be one of the first pilot shops in Karnataka.
finalCta.note: Free use and direct help during the pilot.

aboutPage.title: About GetLekka
aboutPage.mission: Help every small shop keep its accounts by simply speaking.
aboutPage.storyP1: Small shops are the backbone of our neighborhoods in Karnataka and across India. Yet shopkeepers spend hours after exhausting 12-hour days balancing paper books or struggling with complex accounting software.
aboutPage.storyP2: We believe technology should adapt to how people actually work, not the other way around. By bringing voice-based bookkeeping directly onto WhatsApp, GetLekka makes credit tracking as simple as talking to a neighbor.

legal.draftNote: This page is a draft and will be reviewed before launch.

p: GetLekka is a WhatsApp voice assistant for small shops in India. You can reach us at getlekka.hello@gmail.com.
Website: the details you type into our forms (name, shop name, shop type, area, WhatsApp number, preferred language, email and message). We use cookieless analytics, so no tracking cookies are set.
Product (pilot): shop details, your UPI ID, customer names and numbers that you add, credit and payment entries, and your voice notes.
To run the service, to contact pilot shops, and to answer your messages.

sections.h: 4. Where it is stored and for how long
p: Data is stored with our hosting and service providers. We keep it only as long as needed for the pilot and the service, or until you ask us to delete it.
Only service providers who help us run GetLekka: WhatsApp/Meta, speech-to-text, AI model and hosting providers. We never sell your data.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data at any time by emailing getlekka.hello@gmail.com. We follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
GetLekka is not meant for people under 18.
We never ask for your UPI PIN, OTP or bank password. We use HTTPS and limit access to your data to what is needed to run the service.
If we change this policy we will update the date at the top of this page.
For questions, requests or complaints, write to getlekka.hello@gmail.com.
GetLekka lets shop owners keep a credit book by sending voice notes on WhatsApp. The website describes the service and lets you apply for the free pilot.
The pilot is free and still in testing. Features may change, and the service may be interrupted or may make mistakes.
GetLekka shows every entry back to you. You are responsible for checking that entries are correct and for using Undo or correcting them.
GetLekka keeps records. It does not hold, move or collect money on your behalf.
Please use GetLekka only for lawful business record-keeping, and do not misuse or attempt to disrupt the service.
GetLekka works through WhatsApp, so WhatsApp's own terms and policies also apply to you.
To the extent allowed by law, GetLekka is not liable for losses arising from errors in entries, interruptions, or use of the pilot.
You can stop using GetLekka at any time. We may end or change the pilot, or stop access for misuse.
These terms are governed by the laws of India, with courts in Karnataka having jurisdiction.
Questions? Write to getlekka.hello@gmail.com.
